results.rationale: Consistency: white background remains, but all six forks that should survive the count change are absent, removing every major object. Instruction: eight forks become zero, not six; non-compliance. Quality: considered alone, the blank white field is uniform and free of visible structural or texture artifacts.

Consistency: recognizable black/white diamonds remain, but the cushion becomes tall and narrow and its fabric pattern is heavily smeared and disrupted. Instruction: a cool dark-gray urban interior and bold top-left title appear, but the cushion is an implausibly huge upright rectangle with corrupted geometry, and stray text-like bars interrupt the title area.
